recipe.visualDefinition: A desaturated, high-contrast portrait of a man in Western attire, featuring heavy artificial weathering, scratches, and dust textures to simulate a worn physical object. The composition uses a low-angle perspective to emphasize the subject's presence, paired with bold, distressed typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's relaxed posture vs. the aggressive, gritty texture overlay
Monochrome photographic palette vs. a single saturated accent color in the secondary text
Large-scale display typography anchored to the bottom third of the frame
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and scratch texture across the entire image
Low-angle, full-body or three-quarter seating pose

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered but leaning, occupying the middle and upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white, distressed display text at the bottom serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the diagonal line of the body down to the feet, and settle on the bold typography at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, cluttered background with low detail allows the subject and text to pop.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for primary display text
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep saturated red for secondary metadata text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and the dark background; low saturation overall except for the red accent.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to three main tones: black/grey, white, and one warm accent

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight with heavy, blocky serifs
Intentional erosion and 'grunge' texture applied to the fills
characterSpecificRedesigns: Rough, jagged edges on all glyphs to simulate old printing press wear
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed vertical primary text paired with wide, horizontal secondary text for structural balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed, authoritative weight.
Classic slab serif skeletons that match the Western vibe.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, monochrome photograph of a man in a cowboy hat and plaid shirt sitting in a relaxed, leaning pose on a chair in a workshop. Apply a heavy overlay of white scratches, dust, and film grain. Use a low-angle shot.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, condensed slab-serif title in white with a distressed texture across the bottom third. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a wide, bold slab-serif font colored in deep red.

verificationChecks: Is the scratch texture visible over the entire frame?
Is the primary text condensed and the secondary text wide?
Is the red accent color used only for the secondary text?

adjustableVariables: Degree of desaturation (pure B&W vs. sepia)
The specific hue of the red accent
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or faces
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the distress texture.
Check that the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Verify the red text provides a sharp contrast to the monochrome background.
Confirm the scratch overlay doesn't obscure the subject's face.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Western Portrait + Condensed Distressed Slab + Red Accent + Heavy Scratched Texture Overlay
